[[quarkus-extension-schema-reference]]
=== Extension descriptor schema reference

The canonical definition of `META-INF/quarkus-extension.yaml` is the 
link:https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/{quarkus-branch}/independent-projects/tools/devtools-common/src/main/resources/META-INF/quarkus-extension-schema.json[JSON schema].
The extension Maven and Gradle plugins validate the packaged descriptor against this schema.
The tables below are generated from that schema at documentation build time.

Extension authors may reference the schema in template files for IDE assistance:

[source,yaml,subs=attributes+]
----
$schema: "https://quarkus.io/schemas/quarkus-extension-schema.json"
name: "My Extension"
metadata:
  status: "stable"
----

==== Author template fields

[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
| Field | Type | Description
| `artifact`
| string
| Extension runtime artifact coordinates. In the author template this may use Maven expressions such as ${project.groupId}:${project.artifactId}:${project.version}; the build replaces them with resolved coordinates. This field may be omitted from the template.
| `description`
| string
| Description displayed to users. It may be provided in the template or copied from the extension module POM during the build.
| `metadata`
| object
| Extension catalog metadata used by Quarkus dev tools.
| `metadata.categories`
| array of string
| Categories under which the extension appears in tooling (such as https://code.quarkus.io). Prefer existing categories. If this is omitted or free-form categories are used, the extension is still listed but may be harder to find in the tools.
| `metadata.codestart`
| object
| Codestart information. See https://quarkus.io/guides/extension-codestart.
| `metadata.codestart.artifact`
| string
| Maven coordinates of the codestart artifact.
| `metadata.codestart.languages`
| array of string
| Languages supported by the codestart.
| `metadata.codestart.name`
| string
| Codestart name.
| `metadata.config`
| array of string
| Configuration property prefixes exposed by this extension.
| `metadata.guide`
| string
| Link to the extension guide or documentation page.
| `metadata.icon-url`
| string
| URL of a square icon (greater than 220 pixels). Supported formats: png, jpeg, tiff, webp, svg. Optional. If this is not set, the social media preview on the extension source repository will be used in tooling.
| `metadata.keywords`
| array of string
| Keywords used to search for extensions in the extension catalog.
| `metadata.short-name`
| string
| Short name used to quickly locate an extension in the dev tools extension catalog.
| `metadata.status`
| enum: `stable`, `preview`, `experimental`, `deprecated`
| Maturity status. Must be a single string value, not an array. Use deprecated when the extension is likely to be replaced or removed. Evaluated by extension maintainers.
| `metadata.unlisted`
| boolean
| Whether this extension is hidden from default listings and searches in tooling.
| `name`
| string
| Extension name displayed to users.
|===

==== Build-augmented fields

[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
| Field | Type | Description
| `metadata.built-with-quarkus-core`
| string
| Quarkus version the extension was built with. Added by the extension build plugin.
| `metadata.capabilities`
| object
| Capabilities this extension provides or requires. See https://quarkus.io/guides/capabilities. Added by the extension build plugin.
| `metadata.capabilities.provides`
| array of string
| Capabilities provided by this extension.
| `metadata.capabilities.requires`
| array of string
| Capabilities required from other extensions.
| `metadata.extension-dependencies`
| array of string
| Direct dependencies on other extensions. Added by the extension build plugin.
| `metadata.minimum-java-version`
| string
| Minimum Java version required to run this extension. Generated from maven.compiler.release. Added by the extension build plugin.
| `metadata.requires-quarkus-core`
| string
| Quarkus version range required by this extension. Optional; defaults from built-with-quarkus-core. Added by the extension build plugin.
| `scm-url`
| string
| Source code repository URL. Optional in the template; often set automatically from POM SCM information or the CI environment (for example GITHUB_REPOSITORY on GitHub Actions).
| `sponsor`
| string
| Sponsor of this extension. Optional; may be determined automatically from commit history.
|===

==== Extension offering fields

[cols="2,1,3", options="header"]
|===
| Field | Type | Description
| `metadata..+-support$`
| array of string
| Associates the extension with an offering (introduced in Quarkus 3.26). The property name is <offering-id>-support; the value is a list of support scopes such as supported or tech-preview.
|===
